title: Convolve Two Signals
prompt:
Compute the linear convolution of

    x = [1, 4, -2]
    h = [2, 0]

Enter the result as a space-separated row.
hint: y[n] = Σ x[k]·h[n−k]; length is len(x)+len(h)−1
recap: Linear convolution y[n] = Σ x[k]·h[n − k] slides one signal across the other, multiplying and summing — how an LTI system's output is built from its impulse response.
